title: I Will Send My Messenger
old_p1: The Lord gave the prophet Malachi a promise. A prophet speaks for Heavenly Father.
The Lord said, “I will send my messenger.” A messenger is someone sent to share important news.
The messenger would “prepare the way” for the Lord. That means he would help people get ready, like tidying up before a special guest comes.
old_p2: Over 400 years later, John the Baptist helped people get ready for Jesus. He baptized them in the Jordan River. Baptism is a promise, made in the water, to follow Heavenly Father. Jesus said John was the messenger Malachi wrote about.
You can get ready for Jesus too, by being kind like Him. Tonight, think of one kind thing you will do tomorrow.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, the Lord gave Malachi a happy promise. He said, “I will send my messenger.”
This helper would be sent ahead to “prepare the way.” He would help people get ready, like tidying up before a special guest comes.
Then the Lord Himself would come to His temple. Malachi was talking about Jesus.
p2: Many years later, John the Baptist came. He helped people get ready for Jesus and baptized them in the Jordan River. Jesus said John was the messenger Malachi wrote about.
You can get ready for Jesus too, by being kind like Him. Tonight, think of one kind thing you will do tomorrow.
